query:
SELECT id, rfqId, fromChain, toChain, status, expiresAt, settledVia, settledAt, htlcId, createdAt,
       FROM_UNIXTIME(expiresAt/1000) as expires_human,
       CASE WHEN expiresAt < (UNIX_TIMESTAMP()*1000) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE CONCAT('active ~', ROUND((expiresAt/1000 - UNIX_TIMESTAMP())/60), 'min left') END as timelock_state
FROM htlc_secrets
WHERE status IN ('locked', 'revealed')
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
